text:
Olivia: Heads-up — Harmonia (POC) wants to run our adapter with their Llama-variant + custom tokenizer. Can we confirm catalog coverage and any known kv-cache or quant issues? They also asked about per-call pricing for a dedicated pool.
Marcus: @Olivia I ran a quick compat check — our llama-harmonia-v2 is loadable but there's a tokenizer mismatch risk if they use custom merges. Need a sample tokenizer.json and vocab. KV cache behavior looks fine; recommend enabling prefix caching for chat workloads.
Priya: For pricing, rough baseline: hosted usage ~$0.012 / 1k tokens for that variant; dedicated estimate ~"~$3k/mo" for a small reserved pool (100k tokens/day). Final quote depends on expected RPS and burst needs.
Jordan: Security checklist — they requested KMS integration, network isolation (VPC), and SOC2 evidence. We can provide SOC2 report and KMS integration notes, and support private deployment for the POC if required. Also ask about DLP/PII handling rules.
Olivia: I will ask Harmonia for the tokenizer artifacts and fill out the security questionnaire. Marcus, can you run a short perf profile on the 4-bit quantized variant and a non-quant baseline? We need p50/p95 numbers to advise them.
Marcus: Yep. Quick heads-up: 4-bit reduces memory but can add ~10-20% token latency on our kernel for long context. Running now, will paste results.
Marcus: ```bash
# quick perf
redwood run --model llama-harmonia-v2 --quant 4bit --batch 8 --seq 2048 --trace perf
# result snippet
# p50: 72ms/token
# p95: 312ms/token
```
Marcus: Logs uploaded to the ticket (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/8231). Also flagged that fallback to the float16 variant ops smoothly if latency is unacceptable.
Priya: If p95 ~300ms we should recommend dedicated pool or smaller batch sizes; also offer caching suggestions to lower token burn. I'll draft a short pricing options sheet (hosted, committed dedicated, private) and include an example cost for 100k/1M tokens.
Jordan: Add a note: for Private deployment customers, the SLAs and audit attachments change — need to include the enterprise addendum if they plan to store logs longer.
Olivia: Proposed POC plan for Harmonia: week 1 — tokenization & sample corpus validation; week 2 — perf runs + cost tradeoffs; week 3 — integration + security sign-off + optional private deploy trial. Anyone want to tweak?
Marcus: No objections. I'll also prepare a short runbook for common tokenization fixes (strip-bpe mismatch, remap tokens).
Priya: I'll include burst pricing and an example committed discount schedule.
Olivia: Great. I'll collect tokenizer + security QS by EOD and send them the POC plan. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
